name: DeletingDestructor
source: lane DQ: every Any's slot 0 resets the vtable to cIGZAny's (0xd9c654) and deletes on flags & 1

name: Assign
source: lane DQ: copies source's value when source->GetType() == GetType(), returns 1 in al, else 0 (callers such as 0x1bf626 call it through memory)

name: Compare
source: lane DQ: scalars -1/0/1 (this < other is -1); AnyString: held string CompareTo(other's, true); AnyStringSet: 1 when both sets hold the same strings, else 0

name: Clone
source: lane DQ: operator new copy of the same type, null when new fails

name: GetTypeName
source: lane DQ: address of the class's name text, stored right after its 6-slot vtable (vtable + 0x18)
